rubric: A command line change with no web surface: screenshots_or_terminal (the commands and their output).

criteria.format: an API or CLI change: screenshots when there is something to see, else a terminal capture of the commands and the scenarios' tests

reading.why: A command-line flag with no web surface: the commands and their output show it.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: video
ruledOut.why: A command line change. It is not: a UI or flow change a person should watch happen, and the browser run ran on a running system: scenarios the browser drove, a recording or replayable steps, and the video image is there.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: text_only
ruledOut.why: A command line change. It is not: CI/CD, config, infrastructure or a pure refactor: nothing a person could watch or run to see it.
